scope: bounded topical research, not an exhaustive Zhejiang Lab bibliography

sources.title: Falcon: A Remote Sensing Vision-Language Foundation Model (Technical Report)
sources.affiliation_evidence: Research Center for Space Computing System, ZhejiangLab; author block
sources.claim_anchor: model architecture; training setup; README Training Dataset / License
findings: 0.7B model; paper training setting reports 160 A100 GPUs for four days
README still marks Falcon_SFT dataset coming soon
sources.transfer: Represent region, plot context and local observation separately; no remote-sensing inference added
limits: No tea crop labels in current project
Small parameter count does not make reproduction inexpensive
Code MIT does not settle third-party model/data terms

sources.title: SpecCLIP: Aligning and Translating Spectroscopic Measurements for Stars
sources.affiliation_evidence: Guirong Xue and Xiaoyu Tang; Zhejiang Laboratory affiliations in author block
sources.claim_anchor: Introduction CLIP limitation; method auxiliary decoders; Discussion; README tutorials
findings: LAMOST LRS / Gaia XP alignment with reconstruction and cross-modal prediction
Contrastive alignment alone may discard modality-specific information
sources.transfer: Preserve provenance, units, spatial support, quality and unique information of each input; a data-design analogy, not use of the trained encoder
limits: Stellar spectroscopy is a different physical task
No agricultural accuracy transfer
Tutorial checkpoint about 4.5 GB; not downloaded or executed

sources.title: Rhizobacteria protective hydrogel to promote plant growth and adaption to acidic soil
sources.affiliation_evidence: Nannan Li: Research Center for Intelligent Computing Platforms, Zhejiang Lab; author affiliations
sources.claim_anchor: Abstract; root colonization/suberin/auxin results; Authors and Affiliations
findings: Brassica napus and Ensifer C5; PMH protection, colonization and root response under acidic-soil conditions
sources.transfer: Treat soil and root context as distinct information needs; mechanism evidence must retain organism and experiment conditions
limits: Cross-species analogy only
Oilseed-rape treatment effect is not a tea-garden effect
No hydrogel, bacteria or dosage recommendation

sources.title: GeoGPT official models and platform
findings: 70B/72B geoscience models; CPT/SFT/DPO; literature and research workflows
sources.transfer: Separate observed data, literature retrieval and generated explanations
limits: Platform showcase is not independent model evaluation
Model card intended use is non-commercial research/education; individual licenses require review
No model loaded or deployed

sources.title: 021 scientific foundation model ecosystem / GeoGPT-VL official release report
findings: Official description includes GeoGPT-VL scientific image and spatial analysis capabilities
sources.transfer: Design image/chart/document evidence as typed inputs for future extension
limits: No independently identified technical paper or reproducible benchmark for GeoGPT-VL in this bounded search
No verified VL weights or deployment in this project

sources.title: GeoGPT-QA official dataset card
sources.claim_anchor: Dataset Description; License and Intended Uses
findings: Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct synthesizes QA from CC-BY article titles/abstracts
Card describes 40,000 instances; viewer displays 41.4k rows; not independently recounted
Card marks CC BY 4.0 and explicitly warns synthetic records may contain errors
sources.transfer: Use source-bound AI-authored cases for software checks; do not treat generated answers as measured scientific truth
limits: No dataset downloaded; no commit pinned because metadata transport failed
Generated QA does not prove expert review or field validation

sources.title: GeoGPT-CoT-QA official dataset card
sources.claim_anchor: Dataset Description; License and Intended Uses
findings: Full-text-based synthesis by DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B; Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct consistency filtering
Card reports 39,393 instances and CC BY 4.0
sources.transfer: Store concise evidence-to-conclusion justifications with source links; no need to train on synthetic reasoning traces
limits: Model consistency filtering is not expert verification
No dataset downloaded or downstream effect established

sources.title: PEACE: Empowering Geologic Map Holistic Understanding with MLLMs
sources.affiliation_evidence: Microsoft Research; Chinese Academy of Geological Sciences; Wuhan University
findings: Hierarchical Information Extraction; Domain Knowledge Injection; Prompt-enhanced QA
sources.transfer: Parse typed observations before domain-evidence matching and explanation; implement sequential functions
limits: No multi-agent runtime adopted
Geologic-map performance is not tea-garden performance
Incomplete CVF PDF is retained only as a failed transport artifact; HTML is the usable text

sources.title: IPCC AR6 WGII Chapter 1: Point of Departure and Key Concepts
sources.claim_anchor: Executive Summary; risk and adaptation concepts
findings: Risk involves hazards, exposure, vulnerability and responses; interactions and response-related risks matter
sources.transfer: Separate hazard/context/response information; do not invent a multiplicative numeric score
limits: This framework does not calibrate tea-garden loss probabilities

sources.title: Genome-Wide Characterization and Functional Analysis of CsDOF Transcription Factors in Camellia sinensis cv. Tieguanyin Under Combined Heat–Drought Stress
sources.affiliation_evidence: Fujian Agriculture and Forestry University author affiliations
findings: CsDOF expression under controlled heat and PEG stress
Despite combined in title, methods and Figure 9 describe separate heat and drought treatments; not used as demonstrated field combined-stress interaction
sources.transfer: Evidence cards carry cultivar, treatment, time and measured endpoint
limits: 40 C chamber and 10% PEG are laboratory treatments, not operational field thresholds
Gene expression is not a measured yield-loss or irrigation response
No gene/pathway inference from weather alone

sources.title: Steering open-source AI to accelerate the sustainable development goals
findings: Open science and SDG deployment considerations; John Ludden GeoGPT governance role appears in competing interests, not proof of Zhejiang Lab author affiliation
sources.transfer: Describe compute footprint, operational usefulness and environmental benefit as separate evidence questions
limits: Not a model-accuracy study
No measured net climate benefit established for TeaGuard

limits: Radar/ENSO inputs do not match one daily grid
